mutations.mutation: a later attempt may replace a server confirmation
an unmatched or repeated callback settles the exchange it named
a lookup ignores the recording target
erasure keeps the erased owner's outcomes
a replay under another target rewrites an earlier outcome
an append that could not be rolled back is called a definite failure
erasing one owner drops the other owners' unsettled callbacks
replay refines any outcome of an unfinished turn
a failed outcome write fails the turn
a failed outcome update stops the journal checkpoint
the proxy looks outcomes up outside the token's namespace
a retried callback discards what a replay confirmed
an unreadable ledger is reported as not found
